title: SGLang documentation
claims: SGLang documents RadixAttention prefix caching and multi-GPU parallelism for low-latency, high-throughput serving.
It presents itself as a serving framework for language and multimodal models.
notes: No hardware, model or runtime was tested.

title: vLLM Automatic Prefix Caching
claims: vLLM documents PagedAttention KV blocks and automatic prefix caching using token and prefix identity.
notes: Cache efficiency depends on actual request prefixes and configuration.

title: Inside vLLM
claims: vLLM engineering material discusses continuous batching, chunked prefill and prefix caching.
notes: Not a benchmark result for this project.

title: LM Studio API
claims: LM Studio documents a native REST API for local inference and model management plus OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible interfaces.
Its v1 API documents stateful chats, API-token configuration and model lifecycle endpoints.
notes: Version/model support needs runtime verification.

title: LM Studio developer documentation
claims: LM Studio documents local tool/MCP workflows, structured output, embeddings, SDKs and CLI model management.
notes: Feature availability is not assumed for every loaded model.

title: TensorRT-LLM Triton backend
claims: The TensorRT-LLM Triton backend documents in-flight batching, paged attention, KV cache reuse, chunked context, quantization and speculative decoding.
It documents cancellation through a stop request using the same request ID.
notes: NVIDIA deployment was not created or tested.

title: Text Generation Inference
claims: Hugging Face marks TGI as maintenance mode and recommends vLLM, SGLang or local interoperable engines for future optimized serving.
TGI documents continuous batching, tensor parallelism, streaming, PagedAttention, quantization, LoRA and schema-guided generation.
notes: No TGI deployment was run.

title: Text Embeddings Inference API
claims: TEI documents separate embedding, sparse embedding, classification and rerank endpoints plus an OpenAI-compatible embeddings route.
notes: No embedding or rerank quality was measured.

title: ExLlamaV3
claims: ExLlamaV3 documents EXL3 and cache quantization, consumer-GPU tensor/expert parallelism, CPU offload, dynamic batching, speculative decoding and multimodal support.
It recommends TabbyAPI for an OpenAI-compatible server and embedding support.
notes: No consumer GPU setup was tested.

title: MLC-LLM introduction
claims: MLC-LLM documents compiler-accelerated deployment across multiple GPU backends and a REST server.
notes: Model compilation and backend compatibility were not tested.

title: MLC-LLM REST API
claims: MLC-LLM documents CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, ROCm and OpenCL device choices and local, interactive and server presets.
notes: Availability is release and hardware dependent.

title: OpenVINO GenAI
claims: OpenVINO GenAI documents generative pipelines extending OpenVINO runtime and examples with LoRA adapters.
notes: Exact model/device support was not tested.

title: ONNX Runtime Generate API
claims: ONNX Runtime GenAI documents greedy and beam search, top-p/top-k sampling, chat templates and structured output for tool calling.
notes: Exact execution-provider support requires separate verification.

title: OpenRouter RAG guide
claims: OpenRouter documents distinct embedding, rerank and chat operations and provider routing.
notes: No provider, price or retention assertion is made.

title: LiteLLM documentation
claims: LiteLLM documents a provider abstraction and gateway-oriented documentation.
notes: A gateway does not establish a backend feature contract.

title: Ollama API
claims: Ollama publishes local API documentation.
notes: Feature and hardware support remain model and release specific.

title: MLX-LM
claims: MLX-LM provides MLX-based text generation and LoRA or QLoRA fine-tuning documentation.
notes: Apple-platform suitability is a deployment choice, not a measured comparison.

title: KTransformers
claims: KTransformers documents CPU-GPU heterogeneous inference, quantization, MoE optimization and SGLang integration.
notes: Repository performance examples were not adopted as results.

title: Ray Serve
claims: Ray Serve documents scalable online inference APIs with response streaming, dynamic batching and multi-node or multi-GPU serving.
notes: It is a deployment layer and does not establish model-runtime support.

title: OpenRouter RAG capabilities
claims: OpenRouter documents provider routing and separate embedding, rerank and chat operations.
notes: Endpoint availability is provider and model dependent.
